subject: Installing Shiny Server on Debian 8 - 'Dependency is not satisfiable' error

messages.author: 9808cac7dbdd2463
messages.subject: Installing Shiny Server on Debian 8 - 'Dependency is not satisfiable' error
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm attempting to install Shiny Server on a Debian 8 (Jessie) machine, using the Ubuntu pre-built binaries. When trying to run the installer, I get an error reading:

This package is uninstallable
Dependency is not satisfiable: libssl0.9.8

I have the libssl1.0.0 libraries installed - do I also need to install the 0.9.8 version in order to install Shiny Server? If so, has anyone done this and gotten it to work in Debian 8? 

Thanks in advance!
